messages:
maria: Quick q — we need a way in Console to show 'who rolled a routing policy' in the short list and support export for compliance. thinking about minimal vs full context.

raj: Yep. current audit export only has event_id, actor_id, diff_blob. Not great for quick searches.

alex: +1. Suggest adding "actor_display_hint" to the list view plus an indexable actor_email. For exports provide both compact and full NDJSON.

sophie: Is there a PII concern if we include emails in exports? compliance team asked for obfuscated option.

maria: good point. need both: a human-friendly column in UI and an export-mode toggle (raw vs pseudonymized).

raj: For pseudonymization we can include actor_hash and mapping manifest only in enterprise exports behind ACLs.

compliance-bot: FYI — policy-change events must include justification and source_ip per audit policy v2.

alex: sample NDJSON event shape i propose:
```
{"ts":"2026-02-12T15:03:22Z","event":"policy.change","actor_id":"a_123","actor_email":"maria@example.com","actor_hash":"h_abc","target_policy":"route-42","before":{},"after":{"weight":0.8},"justification":"canary rollout to 10%","source":"console"}
```

sophie: That looks fine. For public export we drop actor_email and source_ip; include actor_hint instead.

maria: UX ask — on change list view show an inline "who" pill with hover to reveal obfuscated email + link to export bundle. Also add a small bell for SLA related policy changes.

raj: Implementation note — we need to add actor_email to hot index (search) but ensure it's only accessible to users with export permission. ops-bot can gate this.

ops-bot: deploy-check: new column additions require migration of audit-materialized views. ETA ~3 days dev + 2 days canary.

maria: ok i can prioritize prompts for rollout. next: do we want a single "export bundle" action (ndjson + manifest + signing) or separate endpoints?

alex: bundle is better for compliance. also sign with tenant key. we should include a manifest with mapping method (hash/salt) and retention policy.

sophie: +1. add option to redact source_ip but keep geolocation-country for downstream compliance analytics.

maria: great. i'll sketch product flow and wireframe. pairing with raj for API shape tomorrow.

raj: cool. i'll mock the API: POST /exports/audit?mode=bundle&pii=pseudonymize returns signed url.

maria: thanks team — i'll drop the wireframe in #eng-platform later today. tagging @alex and @sophie for review. :thumbsup:
